the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Deduce the forward direction from functoriality of the relative cycle property under base change, and for the converse test the defining specialization condition against an arbitrary valuation ring by pulling the h covering back to it, refine the induced covering using that h coverings are V coverings so that some member carries a specialization lying over the two points of the valuation ring, realize that specialization internally by a valuation ring map via the Properties lemma, transport the specialization identity from the assumed base changes along the composite valuation ring extension using compatibility of the specialization maps with base change along DVR extensions, and conclude by injectivity of base change on cycles over fields (source lines 989-1019)
